meta.title: Termrise
meta.homeTitle: Termrise: Find rising search terms worth building for
meta.description: Termrise helps indie developers find rising English search terms, check demand with real data, decide what to build and track each launch to its first paying customer.

hero.title: Find rising demand. <line>Build what people search for.</line>
hero.body: Termrise collects rising terms from Google Trends and Hacker News, checks them against search data and the top 10 results, and turns the evidence into product opportunities you can test in 7–14 days.

demo.output: Opportunity: meeting notes for sales teams, with evidence from Trends, Hacker News and the top 10 results

steps.title: From a rising term to a first order.

discover.title: Discover rising terms
discover.body: Collect rising terms from Google Trends and Hacker News, or import your own CSV file.

verify.title: Check the evidence
verify.body: See search volume, CPC, difficulty and the top 10 results. AI inferences are shown apart from facts.

launch.title: Decide, build and launch
launch.body: Choose Go, Validate or No-Go, export a product brief, then record your launch and first orders.

evidence.title: Real data first
evidence.body: A Trends index is not a search volume, and a busy Hacker News thread is not search demand. Termrise shows each number as what it is.

budget.title: A budget for every paid request
budget.body: Each paid data request is reserved, settled and logged against your budget.

brief.title: Briefs for your AI coding tool
brief.body: Export a Markdown product brief: users, problem, competitors, MVP scope, pages, API and tests.

languages.title: English and Chinese
languages.body: The whole app is available in both languages.

start.q: What do I need to get started?
start.a: An email address or a Google account.

sources.q: Where does the data come from?
sources.a: Google Trends, the Hacker News API and DataForSEO, and CSV files that you import. Termrise does not scrape sites without permission.

guarantee.q: Does Termrise guarantee rankings or revenue?
guarantee.a: No. It helps you find and test demand with evidence. Rankings and sales depend on what you build and how you reach your users.

price.a: Termrise is free during early access.

agreement.title: Agreement
body: These Terms govern your use of Termrise at termrise.com (the “Service”). Termrise is operated by Termrise (“we”, “us”). By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these Terms.
You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of majority where you live, to use the Service.

service.title: The Service
body: Termrise runs tasks for you in exchange for credits. Replace this paragraph with what your service does and which AI providers it uses.
AI output can be inaccurate. Review every result before you use it.

account.title: Your account
body: You sign in with an email link or with Google. Keep access to your email and Google account secure. You are responsible for activity on your account.

credits.title: Credits and payments
body: Each task uses 1 credit. New accounts receive 10 free credits.
You can buy credits in one-time packs or with a monthly subscription. Prices are shown in US dollars on the pricing page (termrise.com/pricing).

Payments are processed by Waffo Pancake, our Merchant of Record. Waffo is the seller for the purchase and handles payment, tax and invoicing. A pack is a one-time transaction. When you complete a purchase, you authorize Waffo to charge your payment method the amount shown at checkout.

A subscription renews automatically every month. When you subscribe, you authorize Waffo to charge your payment method the plan price at each renewal until you cancel. Each successful payment adds the plan's credits to your balance.

You can cancel at any time on the Billing page. Your subscription stays active until the end of the period you paid for and does not renew. If a renewal payment fails, Waffo retries once. If that also fails, the subscription ends.
Prices do not include taxes unless the price says so. Where the law requires, taxes are added at checkout.
Credits do not expire, have no cash value and cannot be transferred. If a task fails, its credits are returned to your balance automatically. Refunds for purchases follow our Refund Policy.

disputes.title: Billing disputes
body: If you think a charge is wrong, contact support@termrise.com before you open a dispute or chargeback with your bank. Include the email address on your account and your order number. If the charge is wrong, we refund it in full.

content.title: Your content

You confirm that you own your uploads or have permission to use them, including any trademarks, logos or people shown.
We do not claim ownership of the results you generate. You are responsible for making sure that your use of them is legal and does not infringe the rights of others.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
body: Do not use the Service to create or share content that is illegal, sexualizes minors, harasses people, infringes the rights of others, or misleads people.
Do not try to break, overload or reverse engineer the Service.
We may remove content, refuse a task, or suspend or close accounts that break these rules. To report content or appeal a decision, email support@termrise.com.

termination.title: Termination

When your account is deleted, unused credits expire without refund, unless our Refund Policy or the law requires a refund.
If we close your account for a breach of these Terms, unused credits are not refunded.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What data Termrise collects, how we use it, who we share it with, how long we keep it and your rights.

intro.title: Who we are
body: Termrise (termrise.com) is operated by Termrise We are the data controller for the personal data described in this policy. Contact: support@termrise.com.
This policy explains what personal data we collect, why, and who we share it with.

collect.title: Data we collect
body: Account data: your email address, and your name and profile picture if you sign in with Google.
Content: the text and files you submit, and the results we generate for you.
Billing data: your purchases and credit history. Payment card data is processed only by our PCI-DSS certified payment processor, Waffo Pancake, and is not stored on our servers.
Usage data: pages you visit and actions you take (for example, starting a task), plus technical data such as browser type and error reports. We do not include your email or your input in this data.

use.title: How we use it
body: To sign you in, run and store your tasks, keep your credit balance, process purchases and refunds, prevent abuse, fix errors and improve the Service.

Legal bases: we process account, content and billing data to provide the Service under our contract with you. We process usage and error data for our legitimate interest in keeping the Service secure and working. We use analytics cookies only with your consent. We keep billing records to meet our legal obligations. We count page views without cookies for our legitimate interest in knowing which pages and channels bring visitors.
We do not sell your personal information, including as defined under applicable laws such as the CCPA. We do not use your uploads to train AI models.

share.title: Who we share it with
body: We use these service providers to run Termrise. Each one receives only the data it needs:

Vercel (hosting, cookieless page statistics and page speed measurement) · Neon (database) · Cloudflare R2 (file storage) · Waffo Pancake (payments, Merchant of Record) · Resend (sign-in emails) · Google (optional sign-in) · PostHog (product analytics) · Sentry (error monitoring). Add every AI provider that receives user data.
We may also disclose data when the law requires it.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
body: We use a session cookie to keep you signed in, a cookie that remembers your last sign-in method (Google or email) for 30 days and a NEXT_LOCALE cookie to remember your language. Your theme choice is saved in your browser’s local storage.

Analytics: PostHog sets analytics cookies and receives usage events from your browser only after you accept the cookie banner. If you decline, no analytics cookies are set and no events are sent from your browser. You can change your choice at any time with “Cookie settings” in the footer.

Page statistics: Vercel Web Analytics counts page views and shows which websites and campaigns visitors come from. It sets no cookies and does not identify you. It records the page address without personal IDs, campaign tags in the link (utm_ parameters), the referring website, country, device type, browser and operating system. Vercel tells visits apart with a temporary value derived from the request and discards it after 24 hours.

Page speed: Vercel Speed Insights measures how fast pages load and respond in your browser. It sets no cookies and does not identify you. It records the page address without personal IDs, the page type, the loading-speed measurements and the page element they relate to, network type, country, device type, browser and operating system.

If you are signed in, we also save your choice in your account. Only if you accepted, our servers send account events to PostHog: sign-up, completed purchases and task results. These events use your internal account ID, not your email, and never include your input.

security.title: Data security
body: All traffic to the Service uses HTTPS. Your files are kept in private storage and are opened only through short-lived signed links. Access to our production systems is limited.
If a security incident affects your rights, we notify you and the relevant authorities within 72 hours of discovery, as the law requires.

retention.title: How long we keep it
body: We keep your account data and content while your account is open. Billing records are kept as long as tax and accounting law requires.
After you ask us to delete your account, we delete your data within 30 days, except records we must keep by law.

rights.title: Your rights
body: Depending on where you live, you can ask to access, correct, export or delete your personal data, restrict or object to how we use it, or withdraw your consent at any time. You can also complain to your local data protection authority.
Send requests to support@termrise.com. We reply within 30 calendar days.

marketing.title: Emails and marketing
body: We send only the emails that the Service needs, such as sign-in links. We do not send marketing emails. If we start to, we will ask for your consent first, and each email will have an unsubscribe link.

transfers.title: Where data is stored
body: Our servers and most of our providers are in the United States. If you live elsewhere, your data is transferred to and processed in the United States.
Where the law requires, these transfers are protected by safeguards such as the Standard Contractual Clauses offered by our providers.

children.title: Children
body: The Service is intended for users aged 18 and above. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18. If you think a child has given us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

links.title: Third-party services
body: The Service links to services that other companies run, such as the Waffo checkout and Google sign-in. Their own privacy policies apply when you use them.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy. If a change is material, we tell you by email or in the Service at least 15 days before it takes effect. The date at the top of this page shows the latest version.

contact.title: Contact
body: Privacy questions and requests: support@termrise.com.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.description: Failed tasks return their credits automatically. Unused credit packs and subscription payments can be refunded in full within 14 days. Credits never expire.

failed.title: Failed tasks
body: If a task fails, its credits are returned to your balance automatically. You do not need to contact us.

purchases.title: Credit pack purchases
body: You can get a full refund within 14 days of purchase if you have not used any credits from that pack.
If you were charged twice or charged the wrong amount, we refund the extra charge in full.
After you use credits from a pack, or after 14 days, the purchase is not refundable, unless the law where you live requires a refund.
To request a refund, email support@termrise.com from the email address on your account, with your order number. We review every request and reply by email.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
body: You can cancel your subscription at any time on the Billing page. It stays active until the end of the period you paid for. Canceling does not refund the current period.

You can get a full refund of a subscription payment within 14 days if you have not used any credits from that payment. A refund does not cancel the subscription. To stop future payments, also cancel it on the Billing page.
Credits you received from a subscription stay in your account after the subscription ends.

process.title: How refunds work
body: Payments are processed by Waffo, our Merchant of Record. Approved refunds go back to your original payment method. Your bank may take several business days to show it.

When a payment is refunded, the credits from that pack or subscription payment are removed from your balance. If you have already used some of them, we remove only the credits that remain. Your balance never goes below zero.

expiry.title: Credits do not expire
body: Unused credits stay in your account, also after a subscription ends.

lifecycleHelp.breakout: Gained 100 points or more in the last 6 hours of observations.
